truths.CP2:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching BE-14 lines from 2024
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(n_lines - 1), 0)
FROM line_sets
truths.CP4:
WITH line_sets AS (  -- one row per set of matching BE-14 lines from 2024
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
         ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur AS line_revenue_eur
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE s.store_code = 'BE-14'
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM((n_lines - 1) * line_revenue_eur), 0), 2)
FROM line_sets
